qa_pairs.question: What information is visually represented by the "Puissance utilisé.png" graphic on the Alliance Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Alliance Metrix portal, the "Puissance utilisé.png" graphic provides a visual representation of the power used, specifically within the context of a GPU job.

qa_pairs.question: Which section of the Alliance Metrix portal displays a graphical representation of the power consumed during a GPU task?
qa_pairs.answer: A graphical representation of the power used during a GPU task is displayed in the "Page d'une tâche GPU" section of the Alliance Metrix portal.
